summary: No Azure Resource Graph snapshot was attached to the issue, so I could not inspect the live sre-agent-01 resources. The repository currently lacks an explicit, repo-level validation step for Terraform code for the SRE agent. I propose adding a safe, non-destructive validation script that runs terraform fmt/validate and optional static checks (tflint/tfsec) and is suitable for local and CI use.
root_cause: There is no enforced repository-level validation step for the SRE Agent Terraform configuration. Without a lightweight validation script or CI hook, syntactic issues, formatting drift, or common policy/security misconfigurations may go unnoticed before plan/apply.
risk: Very low. The script performs only local, read-only static checks (format, terraform init with backend disabled, terraform validate, optional static analyzers). It does not run terraform plan or apply and does not modify remote state. It will fail if required CLI tools are missing or if checks fail, which is intended.
verification: 1) Commit the script to the repo and run it locally against the Terraform directory: ./scripts/validate_sre_agent.sh path/to/terraform. 2) Expected result: terraform fmt check passes (or instructs to run terraform fmt), terraform init completes with backend disabled, and terraform validate exits successfully. 3) Optionally install tflint and/or tfsec and re-run to see their output. 4) Add this script as a step in CI (e.g., GitHub Actions) to ensure future commits run the same validations.

fix.patch:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# scripts/validate_sre_agent.sh
# Lightweight, non-destructive validation for the SRE Agent Terraform configuration.
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/validate_sre_agent.sh [path-to-terraform-dir]
# Defaults to current directory if no path provided.

TF_DIR="${1:-.}"

echo "Validating Terraform in: ${TF_DIR}"

# Tool checks
missing_tools=()
for tool in terraform; do
  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    missing_tools+=("$tool")
  fi
done

if [ ${#missing_tools[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "Error: required tools missing: ${missing_tools[*]}"
  echo "Install 'terraform' and re-run. Optional tools: tflint, tfsec (if present they will be run)."
  exit 2
fi

# 1) Formatting check
echo "Running: terraform fmt -check -recursive ${TF_DIR}"
if ! terraform fmt -check -recursive "${TF_DIR}"; then
  echo "terraform fmt check failed. Run 'terraform fmt -recursive ${TF_DIR}' to fix formatting."
  exit 3
fi

# 2) Init without backend to avoid touching remote state
echo "Running: terraform init -backend=false in ${TF_DIR}"
pushd "${TF_DIR}" >/dev/null
terraform init -input=false -backend=false >/dev/null

# 3) Static validate
echo "Running: terraform validate"
if ! terraform validate -no-color; then
  echo "terraform validate failed. Fix configuration before applying."
  popd >/dev/null
  exit 4
fi

# 4) Optional static analyzers (best-effort, non-blocking if not installed)
if command -v tflint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Running: tflint"
  if ! tflint --init >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! tflint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "tflint reported issues. Review tflint output above."
    popd >/dev/null
    exit 5
  else
    echo "tflint passed (or had no actionable output)."
  fi
else
  echo "tflint not installed — skipping. (Recommended for provider/best-practice checks)"
fi

if command -v tfsec >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Running: tfsec"
  if ! tfsec --exclude-checks=AVD* .; then
    echo "tfsec reported issues. Review tfsec output above."
    popd >/dev/null
    exit 6
  else
    echo "tfsec passed (or had no actionable output)."
  fi
else
  echo "tfsec not installed — skipping. (Recommended for security scanning)"
fi

popd >/dev/null

echo "Validation completed successfully for ${TF_DIR}."

human_review_focus: Confirm the repository's Terraform root directory (adjust default path in script if needed).
Decide whether to make tflint/tfsec invocation mandatory in CI or keep them optional (script currently treats them as optional).
Ensure CI runs the script with appropriate working directory and with tools installed; avoid running terraform plan/apply in CI without explicit approval.
If desired, extend the script to enforce org-specific checks (tags, naming conventions) — reviewers should provide exact naming/tag patterns before adding such checks.
